title: PagerDuty (REST API v2, read-only API key)
readScopes: A read-only REST API key (Integrations > API Access Keys, "Read-only API Key"); a scoped OAuth app needs incidents.read, services.read, escalation_policies.read, schedules.read and incident_workflows.read.

checks.title: Resolved incidents of the last 90 days each carry a postmortem or retrospective link
checks.scope: Resolved high-urgency incidents (by default) on the chosen services; reviews kept outside PagerDuty count only through a note or custom field.

checks.title: Each production service's escalation policy has two or more levels
checks.scope: Enabled services, or those given with --pagerduty-service.

checks.title: Each production service's first escalation level is on call for all of the next 7 days
checks.scope: The first level of each service's escalation policy: a named user, or a schedule's final rendered coverage; v3 schedules are not read.

checks.title: An enabled incident workflow or an automation action exists for incident response
checks.scope: The account's incident workflows and automation actions; whether they run on the right incidents is not judged.
